scenes.say: You paid for it, so you'll suffer through it. That's not discipline. That's a bias.
The sunk cost fallacy: continuing something only because you've already put so much into it.
Arkes and Blumer asked: two non-refundable trips on the same weekend. The one you prefer, or the expensive one?
About {sunk} picked the expensive trip, even though they preferred the other one.
The money is gone either way. The only question left is which trip makes you happier.
scenes.show: The money is gone either way.

scenes.say: Ask: starting from zero today, would I still choose this?
